728-3240-6277-6462.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

240-5470-6791-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

5414-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
5414-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability, preventing the next 2 damage dealt to a target this turn.
Repeat from step 3.

4687-4929-5268.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least four counters on it.
4687-4929-5268.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn using its ability from Utopia Vow by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Cryptic Trilobite, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

628-728-3723.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Carnifex Demon.
When Carnifex Demon dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

586-864-3125-4247-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-4247-5477.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Insidious Roots.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

586-864-2292-3125-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2292-3125-7422.description:
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Garrison Excavator.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

1703-4984-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Academy Researchers
When Academy Researchers dies, Fool's Demise first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Academy Researchers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Academy Researchers enters, it triggers, putting Fool's Demise onto the battlefield from your hand attached to Academy Researchers.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

549-1669-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
549-1669-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, you lose 1 life and create a 2/2 artifact creature token.
The earthbending creature enters as an artifact land creature due to Biotransference and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 4 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Thaumatog.

6252-7282-7824.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating two token copies of Boommobile.
When the Boommobile tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
6252-7282-7824.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

64-1987-6259.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
64-1987-6259.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-1987-6259.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1453-4050--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1298-1618-2440-2806.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Reality Strobe.
Reality Strobe triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Ovika triggers, creating a number of creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token for each trigger.
Resolve Reality Strobe.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-2862-7376.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Lord of the Nazgûl
1618-2440-2862-7376.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Charnel Serenade.
Charnel Serenade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Lord of the Nazgûl triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.
1618-2440-2862-7376.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Lord of the Nazgûl. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

3259-3861-6628--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
3259-3861-6628--85--106.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2539-3094-4659-7295-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2539-3094-4659-7295-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

465-3742-4251-4452-7175.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2292-4871-5220-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
2292-4871-5220-6650.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2292-4871-5220-6650.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1692-1809-2489-3732.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}{R}.
1692-1809-2489-3732.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 1 or greater that can attack and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1692-1809-2489-3732.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{R}.
Cast Relentless Assault by paying {2}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Returned Pastcaller with haste.
When the Returned Pastcaller token enters, it triggers, returning Relentless Assault from your graveyard to your hand.
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Nature's Will triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Move to your next main phase and repeat from step 1.

2191-2906-7070.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2191-2906-7070.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Monk Gyatso.
Activate Monk Gyatso by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
Monk Gyatso's ability from step 4 fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
Repeat from step 2.

5686-6872--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5686-6872--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a persist creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Long Feng trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other persist creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2793-3365-3743-5089-6441.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3365-3743-5089-6441.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Aeromoeba by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

1251-1563-2457-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three lore counters on it

112-676-1283-6577.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creature tokens.
112-676-1283-6577.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Summon: Esper Valigarmanda triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its fourth chapter ability.
Holding priority, cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, removing a lore counter from Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Resolve the Summon: Esper Valigarmanda ability, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, putting a lore counter on Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Summon: Esper Valigarmanda's fourth chapter ability triggers.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

224-1993-4543.notablePrerequisites: You control fewer than nine lands.
224-1993-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Budoka Gardener
If the land enters untapped and can produce mana, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.

147-413-6476.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
147-413-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

380-2232-6440--94.description:
Cast the Dragon in your hand without paying its mana cost.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers if the Dragon isn't an artifact and Miirym triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, if applicable, choosing to return nothing.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a token copy of the Dragon that isn't legendary if the Dragon was legendary.
When the Dragon token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the Dragon cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

575-1207-5414.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.
575-1207-5414.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability.
Repeat.

609-3957-4613.notablePrerequisites: Famished Paladin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
609-3957-4613.description:
Activate Famished Paladin using Mine Worker's ability by tapping it, causing you to gain 1 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

814-2034-3094-4853.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Soldiers.
Myrel does not have summoning sickness.
814-2034-3094-4853.description:
Declare Myrel as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Myrel's ability.
Resolve the copy of Myrel's ability, creating at least two 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
When the Soldier dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.

3774-4110-4499.notablePrerequisites:
Luxior attached to Gideon.
You control creatures that can tap to produce at least {4}.
3774-4110-4499.description:
Activate creatures by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Gideon's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Gideon.
Activate Luxior's first equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Gideon.
Repeat.

141-2292-3440.description:
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Demonic Gifts, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Demonic Gifts.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities from step 5.

2178-4265-4826.notablePrerequisites:
Archelos is tapped.
Royal Assassin does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Royal Assassin.
2178-4265-4826.description:
Whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control, it enters tapped due to Archelos.
Holding priority, activate Royal Assassin by tapping it, destroying the creature.
The creature dies, triggering Royal Assassin, untapping Royal Assassin.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2076-3705-5231.description:
Cast Squee, the Immortal by paying {R}{R}.
Birgi and Hazoret's Monument trigger.
Resolve Birgi's trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve Hazoret's Monument's trigger, allowing you to discard a card to draw a card.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Repeat.

225-539-1257-3756.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Walking Atlas as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

1992-2292-2744.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-2292-2744.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying one.
Repeat.
